## normalizeDialect() function

Resolve a user-supplied database name to a canonical [Dialect](./database.dialect.md)<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function normalizeDialect(value: string): Dialect;
```

value

</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

**Returns:**

[Dialect](./database.dialect.md)

The canonical dialect.

## Exceptions

Error if the value matches no known dialect. The message lists the accepted aliases.

## Remarks

Accepts the common aliases people actually type in `DB_CONNECTION` or a URL scheme — `pg`<!-- -->, `pgsql`<!-- -->, `postgresql`<!-- -->, `mariadb`<!-- -->, `sqlite3` — so configuration does not depend on remembering the internal spelling. Matching is case-insensitive.

## Example


```ts
normalizeDialect('POSTGRESQL') // 'postgres'
normalizeDialect('mariadb')    // 'mysql'
```
